thread:
alyssa: Heads-up — surfaced a bunch of billing mismatches in the route dashboard. Looks like console-originated requests are getting attributed to the service account's project instead of the org/project shown in the console UI. Not ideal for customers.

dan: Oh nice catch. Is this when a console admin is impersonating an SA or when they use the 'run as project' dropdown?

alyssa: Mostly the impersonation case. Console creates an exchange token that has both org and sa claims. Our attribution pipeline picks the SA project from the token instead of the 'effective_project' header we add later.

vikram: We currently record headers like: `X-Request-Auth: org=org_123; sa=svc-billing; effective_project=proj_999` but the metrics emitter only ingests `sa` and `org` and drops `effective_project`.

elaine: That design was for simplicity but yep i can see why it's wrong for console flows. Two quick options: 1) change emitter to prefer explicit `effective_project` header when present, 2) keep current and add a post-processing remap in billing pipeline. Tradeoffs?

dan: Option 1 is simpler UX-wise but means more producers need to set effective_project correctly. Option 2 is low-risk but opaque and delays fixes. Also sampling + retention for full token claims is limited, so post-processing might miss edgecases.

alyssa: I'd lean option 1 with a short rollout: emitter checks `effective_project` then `sa` then `org`. We gate with a flag and a 24h canary in staging -> prod. Need to think telemetry and dashboard changes though.

ops-bot: deploy flagged: feature/attr-prefer-effective_project toggled to CANARY in staging.

vikram: Another concern: what if `effective_project` is user-provided or malformed? We should canonicalize and validate against project index (deny unknowns or set to `unknown_project`).

elaine: Agreed. Also add a metric `attribution_fallback_reason` with labels {from_header, from_sa, from_org, unknown} so we can monitor regressions once the flag flips.

dan: For the console UI, we should add a tiny badge on route panels: "attributed to proj_999 (via console)" with a hover explaining claim source (effective_project / service account / org). That will help support triage.

alyssa: Good. Also raising a UX edge: when console users do a cross-project run (run-as another project) we need to show which billing account will be charged — customers ask for explicit confirmation. Can we reuse effective_project field for that prompt?

vikram: Yes, but be careful about delegated tokens where the SA is in a third-party org. Example flow: user in org A runs as proj X, exchange token has sa from org B. Which project billed? That's the whole ambiguity.

elaine: Policy decision required: do we bill the explicitly chosen `effective_project` (console intent) or the token issuer SA project by default? I think the console intent should win for UX predictability, but we must require an admin opt-in for cross-org-billing to avoid charge spikes.

dan: Legal/security might require audit logs that show both: `billing_project` and `token_origin_project`. Add both columns to the route export.

alyssa: Agreed — we'll emit both fields. For telemetry index, proposal: `billing_project`, `token_project`, `attribution_source`. `attribution_source` values = ["effective_project","service_account","org_fallback","unknown"].

ops-bot: auditlog: config change recorded by alyssa at 1719302520.

vikram: Implementation plan: 1) emitter code update (prefers effective_project) behind feature flag, 2) validation against project index, 3) add `attribution_fallback_reason` metric, 4) update dashboards/route export + console badge, 5) 24h canary then ramp. I can take emitter + validation.

alyssa: Thanks. I'll own dashboard + UX copy and coordinate with legal about cross-org defaults. Dan can add the export columns and product note.

sre-jen: Heads up on quota enforcement: if attribution changes, quota accounting must still use the actual enforcing key. We need to keep separate counters: `enforced_by_key` vs `billed_to_project`. Otherwise quota alerts will be misleading.

eleine: (typo) — elaine here: +1 to jen. we'll add the two counters. Also add a nightly reconciliation job that compares billing vs quota for first week after rollout.

alyssa: Great. Timeline? Can we get a staging canary today and prod ramp tomorrow if no surprises?

vikram: I'll cut the PR now and request review. If we merge in 2 hours we can flip CANARY and run tests.

dan: I'll draft the UI copy and export spec. Tagging @legal for cross-org billing policy discussion.

alyssa: Awesome — thanks everyone. We'll monitor `attribution_fallback_reason` and `billing_vs_quota_delta` for the first 72h.

ops-bot: metric alert rule added: `billing_vs_quota_delta > 0.05` -> notify #eng-platform-canary.
